To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have: (1) developed and implemented a method for the calculation of B-meson mixing on the lattice that allows us to calculate the matrix element with high precision, (2) performed the calculation with unprecedented precision using dynamical domain-wall quarks, and (3) found a value for the mixing matrix element that is in excellent agreement with experimental results and the global CKM unitarity ﬁt.
we have developed a method to calculate B-physics observables using a lattice formulation that allows for the inclusion of the full QCD spectrum, including the light quark sector and b quarks.
the lattice QCD simulations of the B physics observables, such as B-meson mixing, decay constant and form factors, are now at a precision comparable to that of the experimental data.
